title: Wellwisher / Today
question: Which composition should anchor the Today surface? Each keeps Today first, Week close at hand, and makes a focused work session feel like a supported choice rather than a demand.

options.label: One clear next thing
options.thesis: Put one calm, authoritative recommendation at the center. Open a lightweight focus session from it, then make the rest of the day and week feel safely held in the background.
options.viewport: desktop Today surface, responsive down to mobile
options.risk: The single recommendation could feel too narrow if the week context is not kept visibly close.

options.label: Week ribbon
options.thesis: Let the week provide the reassuring frame first: day-level allocations across the horizon, with Today and the focus-session recommendation immediately beneath it.
options.viewport: desktop Week-aware Today surface, collapsible on mobile
options.risk: The week can compete with the emotional clarity of the one thing you should do now.

options.label: Voice companion stage
options.thesis: Give the accompanying voice a visible home beside the recommendation. The product feels like someone is with you in the day, without turning into a chat transcript or reading the screen aloud.
options.viewport: desktop companion layout, stacked gracefully on mobile
options.risk: The voice presence may become the visual subject instead of the work you came to do.
